_readme: Jira label vocabulary. This is DATA, not code.
Adding a client or a new scope happens here, without touching scripts.
Any alc-* or cli-* label missing from this file is reported as unknown,
so a typo is noisy instead of silently falling into the default case.
priority: precedence when a ticket carries more than one scope.
Highest wins. A release takes the maximum across its tickets.
Label values and display text stay in Spanish on purpose: the labels
must match Jira exactly, and the display text is read by Mesa de Ayuda.
